instruction: Export the LibreOffice Impress presentation to a PNG image file and save it as res.png on the Desktop. Use the default export settings.

metadata.explanation: Checks if the exported PNG file exists and has reasonable dimensions (at least 800x400 pixels). The presentation has a 16:9 aspect ratio with one slide. Verified: PNG export should produce image with dimensions suitable for presentation viewing.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts PNG file from the specified path (/home/user/Desktop/res.png) matching the instruction
File existence check properly verifies that the export operation created the file
Dimension validation (min 800x400) provides reasonable verification that export completed with sensible settings
Error handling is robust - handles missing files and image read errors appropriately
Postconfig includes sleep to allow file system to stabilize after export
Uses official get_vm_file function and PIL correctly for image inspection
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Metric could explicitly validate the 'format' field extracted by getter to ensure file is actually PNG format (currently only implicit via PIL.Image.open success)
Minor: The instruction specifies 'default export settings' which is verified indirectly through dimension thresholds - this is reasonable but not a direct verification of export settings
